meta.note: CLASSIFICATION BREAK (Dec 2023): Large Hydro Power (>25 MW) was folded into the renewable-energy total starting Dec 2023. Before that it reads 0 MW; after, ~46,910 MW — a definitional change, not a capacity addition. The Grand Total carries the step (+48 GW in one month: 132.7 → 180.8 GW). Growth rates are never computed across this seam. Individual sources (Solar, Wind, Small Hydro, Bio) are unaffected.
